description: This file contains the implementation of an Android Service named AlarmService. It demonstrates starting a background thread that waits for 15 seconds and then stops the service. The service manages notifications, binder communication, and includes comments explaining its behavior relevant to alarm functionality, threading, and Android service lifecycle.

classes.name: AlarmService
classes.description: An Android Service that runs a background thread to simulate a timed task (wait for 15 seconds) and manages notifications and binder for client interactions.

classes.name: AlarmBinder
classes.description: A Binder subclass used for client-service interaction, implementing default transaction handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notification, and starts the worker thread.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the service is destroyed, including canceling notifications and showing a toast message.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns the binder object to clients binding to the service.

methods.name: showNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a persistent notification indicating that the service is running.
